comments_fish: Spawning pair observed under WCB. Many recently emerged fry observed - likely RB, no other trout documented in watershed.
comments_site: Overall fair rearing habitat due to not very abundant cover. Overwintering habitat is available in the lake upstream. Spawning poor - only in sparse gravel patches present, however utilized - newly emerged RB fry observed. Pair of RB also observed spawning under the WB culvert. Given the presence of spawning fish and fry at the same time it appears that RB spawning is flexible in this creek (~1500m elevation). It happens either in the early or late summer depending on the timing of freshet.  Stream is mismapped in TRIM - flows out of "boot" shape lake (02090MAHD) located west of the crossing.

comments_site: No fish habitat. Squishy willow corridor 10 - 15 m wide, no scour or alluvium present. Water collects at the crossing due to slightly perched culvert. No connection to fish-bearing waters. Original drainage is located ~15 m to the west of culvert at UTM 10.679079.5713798; seeps through gentle gully at BRG=310° and completely dissappears in wetland at site UTM. Mismapped in TRIM - does not originate in the cluster of four lakes upstream.

comments_site: No fish habitat. Seasonal stream with no instream cover or seasonal habitat to support any seasonal fish use.  Calculated water velocity at high flows = 4.3 m/s, at low flows = 2.4 m/s, and which exceedes swimming capabilities of RB to move in. At present it flows at BRG = 305° in ditch on the north side of unmapped rough road from the diversion point and then down towards the Long Island Lake.
